arabic text: SUNAAYI KISNE YEH ZINDAA(N) ME LORI SAKINA SO\nRAHI HAI)
english translation text: Who sang this lullaby in\nthe prison? Sakina is sleeping.

arabic text: KHUDARA ZOR SE BOLE NA KOI\nSAKINA SO RAHI HAI
english translation text: For God’s sake, let no one\nspeak loudly; Sakina is sleeping.

arabic text:
KAHAN BANU NE UTHO SHAHZADI
HUWI KYA BAAT KYUN MADARSE RUTHI,
(UTHO BABA KA SAR AAYA HAI BIBI)
MAGAR ZINDA(N) KI HAR DIWAR BOLI
SAKINA SO RAHI HAI
english translation text:
Banu said, ‘Rise, princess. What has happened—why
are you upset with your mother?
Rise, your father’s head has come,
my Lady.’ But every wall of
the prison replied: ‘Sakina is sleeping.’

arabic text:
TUMHAARE GOSHWAARE MILGAYE HAIN
DAR-E-ZINDAAN SAARE KHULGAYE HAIN
(RIHAYI MILGAYI JAATI HUN GHARKO)
MAGAR SAJJAD KI AWAAZ AAYI
SAKINA SO RAHI HAI
english translation text:
‘Your earrings have been found;
every prison door has opened.
We have been freed and
are going home.’ But Sajjad’s
voice came: ‘Sakina is sleeping.’

arabic text:
HUWE JAB SHAAM KE SAAYE BHI GEHRE
PARINDE CHEHCHAHAHTE JAA RAHE THE
(KAHAN BANU NE AY URTE PARINDON)
SADAAYEN ROKLO KUCH DER APNI
SAKINA SO RAHI HAI
english translation text:
When the shadows of Shaam deepened
and the birds flew away
chirping, Banu said, ‘O flying
birds, silence your calls for
a little while—Sakina is sleeping.’
